finding.title: 3 pages load 5+ render-blocking files
finding.detail: Worst: 7 blocking stylesheets/scripts on http://127.0.0.1:58410/. The browser cannot paint anything until each one downloads and parses, which is a direct hit to Largest Contentful Paint.
finding.fix: Add defer to scripts that are not needed for first paint, load non-critical CSS with media="print" onload, and merge the small files that remain.
finding.snippet:
<script src="/app.js" defer></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/extra.css" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">

before_head:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/reset.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/layout.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/theme.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/widgets.css">
<script src="/js/vendor.js"></script>
<script src="/js/app.js"></script>
<script src="/js/analytics.js"></script>
after_head:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/layout.css">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/reset.css" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/theme.css" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/css/widgets.css" media="print" onload="this.media='all'">
<script src="/js/vendor.js" defer></script>
<script src="/js/app.js" defer></script>
<script src="/js/analytics.js" defer></script>
